computed.description: Computed labels, table layouts, TOC tree and citation map for frontends.

sync_required.description: SSE `sync_required` payload emitted when replay detects a gap.

ephemeral_preview.description: SSE `ephemeral_preview` payload for transient typewriter previews.

agent_presence.description: SSE `agent_presence` payload for live agent activity.

ephemeral_clear.description: SSE `ephemeral_clear` payload for immediate placeholder cleanup.

comment_updated.description: SSE `comment_updated` payload for live review-thread changes.

comment_thread.description: Side-channel review thread returned by the comments REST API and MCP tools.

document_sync.description: Applied snapshot delta used for incremental frontend synchronization.

document_diff.description: Structured block-level diff between two revisions.

document_metadata_diff.description: Non-block metadata flags included in a document diff.

chart_data_table.description: Structured ECharts data table projected from a chart block.

patch_outcome.description: Receipt returned by the in-memory patch engine.

ReportDocument.description: The root report document. Blocks are stored in display order.

session_id.description: Optional agent session used for frontend session discovery (`X-Session-Id`).

CoverConfig.description: Configuration for the generated cover page.

variant.description: One of `classic`, `modern`, `minimal`, `split`, `custom`; unknown values render as classic.

date.description: Human-readable publication date. Free-form on purpose (for example "Q3 2026").

meta.description: Optional key/value metadata rendered on the cover.

custom_html.description: Full HTML override for the cover body. When present it replaces the generated cover body.

max_depth.description: Maximum heading depth to include. Protocol range is 1..=3.

variant.description: One of `standard`, `numbered`, `dotted`; unknown values render as standard.

page_break_before.description: Start the TOC on a new page after the cover.

page_break_after.description: Start body content on a new page after the TOC.

ThemeConfig.description: Theme configuration. Tokens are CSS custom properties applied to `.report-root`.

preset.description: Built-in preset name. Unknown presets fall back to `default`.

tokens.description: Additional or overriding CSS custom properties, for example `--rpt-primary`.

custom_css.description: Arbitrary CSS. It is automatically scoped under `.report-root`.

page_chrome.description: Optional A4 paged header/footer slots with template placeholders.

PageChromeConfig.description: A4 paged header/footer configuration stored under `theme.page_chrome`.

PageChromeSlots.description: A three-slot page header or footer row.

HeadingPageBreak.description: Automatic page-break policy for document headings.

SourceEntry.description: A citation source. Source IDs live in the key of [`ReportDocument::sources`].

date.description: Publication date, preferably ISO-8601 (`2026-03-01`) but free-form is accepted.

excerpt.description: Short verbatim evidence excerpt used by reviewers and agents.

Block.description: A report block with common metadata shared by all variants.

id.description: Short semantic ID, for example `q3-revenue`. Empty/missing IDs are auto-assigned on insert.

source_ids.description: Citation source IDs attached to the whole block.

lint_ignore.description:
Suppressible lint rules ignored for this block only. Core contract and safety rules
remain active regardless of this list.

oneOf.description: Section heading. Level 1..=6; headings auto-generate the TOC.

text.description: Heading text. Inline Markdown is supported.

oneOf.description: Prose paragraph with inline Markdown and `[^source_id]` citations.

text.description: Paragraph text. Supports **bold**, *italic*, `code`, links and citations.

oneOf.description: Pull quote with the same inline Markdown/citation support as paragraphs.
Recursive multi-level table. Never compute colspan/rowspan manually.
ECharts chart with mandatory fallback summary.

title.description: Optional chart title. `caption` is accepted as a legacy alias on input.

option.description: Complete native ECharts 6.0 option object. Required: no presets or mode switches.

option_patch.description: Deep-merged onto the base option. Arrays replace arrays, objects merge recursively.

fallback_summary.description: Mandatory one-sentence numeric summary for reviewers, Markdown projection and non-JS use.

numbering.description: `figure` by default; use `none` to suppress the `图 N` label.

note.description: Explanatory footnote rendered below the chart.

oneOf.description: Trusted raw HTML with mandatory fallback text.

BlockStyle.description: Common style controls available on every block.

variant.description: Optional renderer hint, for example `callout` or `numbered`.

keep_together.description: Prevent this block from being split across pages where the renderer supports it.

column_widths.description: Per-leaf-column CSS widths, keyed by leaf column key. Accepts `%`, `px`, `rem` or numbers.

title.description: Outer table title (legacy alias `caption` is also accepted on input).

columns.description: Recursive column tree. Use this shape OR `headers` shorthand, not both.

rows.description: Body rows keyed by leaf column key.

summary_rows.description: Footer rows with the same key shape as `rows`.

oneOf.description: Number as a figure (`图 1`).
Number as a table (`表 1`).
Do not number.

ColumnNode.description: A column node in a possibly multi-level table header.

key.description: Stable leaf key. Must be unique among all leaf columns. Groups may omit it.

children.description: Child columns for a grouped/multi-level header. Empty means this node is a leaf.

weight.description: Relative width weight for `grow` columns (and a multiplier for `fit` columns).

ColumnDataType.description: Inferred or explicit data type of a table column.

oneOf.description: Free-form text, left aligned.
Numeric value, right aligned.
Currency amount, right aligned.
Percentage, right aligned.
Date string, center aligned.
Short status token rendered as a badge, center aligned.

ColumnSizing.description: How a leaf column participates in width distribution.

oneOf.description: Size close to its P90 content width.
Take a weighted share of available table width.

CellValue.description: A table cell value. Untagged so agents can submit plain strings/numbers or rich cells.

RichCell.description: A rich table cell with presentation hints. At least one of `text` or `number` is expected.

title.description: Outer table title (legacy alias `caption` is also accepted on input).

headers.description: Header labels; column keys and data types are inferred.

TableBlock.title: TableBlock
TableBlock.description: Canonical table with a recursive `columns` tree and row objects, OR compact shorthand with `headers` and two-dimensional `rows`/`summary_rows`. The two shapes are mutually exclusive.

CustomHtmlBlock.description: Raw HTML block. Custom HTML is trusted at render time, but must supply a fallback summary.

title.description:
Outer title. Put titles here only; never duplicate them inside the HTML. `caption` is
accepted as a legacy alias for consistency with tables and charts.

numbering.description: `none` by default for freeform HTML; `figure` opts into `图 N` numbering.

note.description: Explanatory footnote rendered below the block.

html.description: Raw HTML trusted by the external renderer.

css.description: Optional CSS scoped under `.report-root` by the frontend.

fallback_text.description: Non-empty plain-text/Markdown fallback. Required for lint cleanliness and agent review.

LintConfig.description:
Document-level lint policy. Ignore entries accept a rule code (`QR202`), a semantic rule name
(`table-empty-column`) or a category prefix (`QR2`). Non-suppressible rules cannot be ignored.

ComputedDocumentMeta.description: Everything the external frontend needs beyond the canonical Block AST.

block_framing.description: Auto-numbering labels and source attribution for table/figure blocks.

chart_requirements.description: ECharts map/extension dependencies grouped by chart block.

chart_tables.description: Structured chart data tables grouped by chart block.

total_width_pct.description: Always 100.00 when at least one leaf exists.

LayoutHeaderCell.description: A resolved multi-level table header cell.

LayoutLeafColumn.description: A layout-ready leaf column with normalized percentage width.

width_pct.description: Normalized percentage. All leaves in a layout sum to 100.00.

plain_text.description: Plain-text citation line, useful for LLM digests and non-HTML consumers.

excerpt.description: Optional verbatim evidence excerpt supplied with the source.

number.description: Hierarchical number such as `2.1`; frontends may hide it for the standard variant.

BlockFraming.description: Pre-computed outer framing for a numbered visual block.

label.description: Exact label shared with Markdown projection, for example `表 1` or `图 2`.

attribution.description: Formatted source attribution/note line, when sources or a note exist.

ChartRequirements.description: ECharts maps and extension series that the frontend must register before rendering.

required_extensions.description: Extension series types such as `wordCloud`, `liquidFill` or `bar3D`.

ChartDataTable.description:
Renderer-agnostic tabular projection of an ECharts option.

The same tables power Markdown review and the frontend `computed.chart_tables` payload.

PatchOp.description:
A declarative mutation. Deserialized with a `type` discriminator.

The large `PatchBlock` variant is intentional: boxing it would force every JSON caller and
store adapter to unwrap an extra pointer for a cold error path.

oneOf.description: Insert blocks immediately after an existing anchor block.

target_id.description: Existing block ID used as the anchor.

oneOf.description: Insert blocks immediately before an existing anchor block.

target_id.description: Existing block ID used as the anchor.

oneOf.description: Append blocks at the end of the report.

Insert blocks at the end of a heading section (before the next heading of the same or
higher level, or at end-of-document).

section_id.description: Heading block that owns the section.

oneOf.description: Partially update one existing block.

patch.description: Partial patch. Unsupported fields return a self-healing error.

oneOf.description: Replace an inclusive range with new blocks.

start_id.description: First block ID in the replaced range.

end_id.description: Last block ID in the replaced range (inclusive).

blocks.description: Replacement blocks. Empty means delete the range.

oneOf.description: Delete one or more blocks.

block_ids.description: Block IDs to delete. All must exist.

oneOf.description: Move one block. `after_id: null` moves it to the top.

after_id.description: Anchor block; null means the beginning of the report.

oneOf.description:
Server-side configuration operation. Dedicated MCP tools use this internally so that
configuration changes are revisioned, streamed and reversible just like block changes.
Replace the complete document lint policy.
Replace the full source registry. Used for rollback and source deduplication.

sources.description: Complete replacement source registry keyed by source_id.

BlockPatch.description: Partial patch for a single block.

lint_ignore.description: Set the block-level lint ignore list. Empty clears it.

option.description:
Replace the ECharts effective option wholesale, clearing any stored `option_patch`.
Supply `option_patch` in the same patch to replace the base and then deep-merge a smaller
overlay.

option_patch.description: Deep-merged into an ECharts block's existing `option_patch`.

height.description: Replace the chart canvas height in pixels.

title.description:
Replace the outer visual title. Empty string clears it. `caption` is accepted as a legacy
alias.

numbering.description: Replace automatic figure/table numbering; `null` leaves it unchanged and `"none"` disables.

note.description: Replace the explanatory footnote. Empty string clears it.

append_rows.description: Append rows to a table's body.

BlockStylePatch.description: Partial style update. Omitted fields are preserved; empty string variants clear the field.

variant.description: Renderer hint. Empty string clears it.

page_break_before.description: Force a page break before this block.

column_widths.description: Per-leaf-column CSS widths keyed by column key. Example: `{"region":"24%","q1":"120px"}`.

CellUpdate.description: Update one table cell by row index and leaf key.

row_index.description: Zero-based row index within `rows` (or `summary_rows` when `summary = true`).

column_key.description: Leaf column key whose cell should be replaced.

value.description: New primitive or rich cell value.

RevisionDelta.description:
Payload of an SSE `revision` event.

Emitted after each committed revision, in strictly ascending revision order.

actor.description: Agent or admin identity recorded for the audit trail.

ops.description: Forward patch operations; metadata-only revisions may carry an empty array.

cleared_preview_ids.description:
Ephemeral previews atomically superseded by this revision.

The frontend removes these previews in the same frame that applies the revision, so the
committed block replaces the streamed placeholder with no visual flicker.

SessionDelta.description: Payload of an SSE `doc_created` event on the session discovery stream.

SyncRequiredDelta.description:
Payload of an SSE `sync_required` event.

Sent when replay detects a gap or a storage failure. Clients must fetch a full snapshot
from `GET /api/docs/{doc_id}` before resuming from a new revision cursor.

since_revision.description: Last revision the stream delivered before detecting the gap.

EphemeralPreviewEvent.description:
Payload of an SSE `ephemeral_preview` event.

Preview frames never enter the revision log. The server stamps `doc_id` and `received_at`
from the request path and wall clock so producers cannot spoof either field.

preview_id.description: Stable stream identity, normally the Runtime `tool_call_id`.

actor.description: Agent identity that produced the preview.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; clients discard frames older than the latest seen value.

ttl_ms.description: Client-side cleanup deadline for abandoned streams.

PreviewAnchor.description: Where an ephemeral preview block sits relative to the committed document.

oneOf.description: Append below the section heading identified by `section_id`.
Insert directly after the committed block.
Insert directly before the committed block.
Temporarily replace a committed block, for example a placeholder heading.
Append after the last committed block in the document.

PreviewStatus.description: Lifecycle state of one ephemeral preview stream.

PartialBlockPreview.description:
Incrementally streamed block content rendered before the revision is committed.

Text blocks carry partial `text`; tables and charts may only carry `title` while streaming so
the frontend can render a skeleton. `block_id` is pre-allocated when known and must match the
eventual committed block for seamless replacement.

block_type.description: Canonical block type, for example `paragraph`, `heading`, `table` or `echarts`.

status.description: Free-form presence state such as `writing` or `idle`.

EphemeralClearEvent.description: Immediate client-side cleanup for previews that will never become a revision.

preview_ids.description: Preview IDs to remove from the frontend immediately.

CommentStatus.description:
Review-thread lifecycle.

Agents may move `open` to `addressed`; only the human REST surface may archive or reopen.

EphemeralPayload.description: Tagged union accepted by `POST /api/docs/{doc_id}/ephemeral` and forwarded over SSE.

oneOf.description:
Payload of an SSE `ephemeral_preview` event.

Preview frames never enter the revision log. The server stamps `doc_id` and `received_at`
from the request path and wall clock so producers cannot spoof either field.

preview_id.description: Stable stream identity, normally the Runtime `tool_call_id`.

actor.description: Agent identity that produced the preview.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; clients discard frames older than the latest seen value.

ttl_ms.description: Client-side cleanup deadline for abandoned streams.

oneOf.description: Payload of an SSE `agent_presence` event.

status.description: Free-form presence state such as `writing` or `idle`.

oneOf.description: Immediate client-side cleanup for previews that will never become a revision.

preview_ids.description: Preview IDs to remove from the frontend immediately.

oneOf.description: Payload of an SSE `comment_updated` event.

CommentThread.description: A side-channel review thread anchored to one or more blocks.

block_id.description: Starting block. Kept as the canonical section/order anchor.

end_block_id.description: Ending block for a cross-block selection. `None` for a single-block anchor.

anchor_blocks.description: Every selected block in document order, including intermediate tables, images and charts.

anchor_snapshot.description: Truncated visible text captured when the thread was created.

end_quote.description: End-block text snapshot for cross-block selections.

anchor_detached.description: True when none of `block_id`, `end_block_id` or `anchor_blocks` still exist.

TextQuoteSelector.description: Text-selection anchor that avoids brittle character offsets.

CommentMessage.description: One message in a review thread.

CommentAuthorType.description: Who wrote a comment or reply.

DocumentSyncDelta.description:
Applied document changes between two committed revisions.

`block_ids` is always the complete target order. `upserted_blocks` contains only added or
modified blocks; unchanged blocks can be retained by the client. Optional configuration fields
are present only when their values changed. `computed` is projected from the target snapshot by
the canonical Rust implementation.

order_changed.description: True when surviving blocks changed relative order.

BlockDiffEntry.description: One block-level change between two snapshots.

DocumentMetadataDiff.description: Non-block document fields that changed between two snapshots.

PatchOutcome.description: Receipt for an applied mutation batch.

id_mapping.description: Map of submitted block IDs to final IDs. Colliding or empty IDs are auto-assigned.

assigned_ids.description: Block IDs auto-assigned because the submitted ID was empty or colliding.

IdAssignment.description: Mapping produced when an empty or colliding block ID was auto-assigned.

requested.description: Original ID, or `None` when the caller omitted/emptied it.

rule.description: Kebab-case semantic rule name, for example `table-empty-column`.

hint.description: Actionable next step, including valid IDs/enums when possible.

suppressible.description:
Whether callers may suppress this diagnostic through `LintConfig.ignore` or
`Block.lint_ignore`. Core contract and safety rules are never suppressible.

suppressed.description: Suppressible diagnostics hidden by document/block/call ignore filters.
